source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (master licence register PDF)
why_relevant: Single authoritative roster of every bank, microfinance institution (IMF), non-bank financial institution (IFJB), insurer, broker, bureau de change (ZKV), payment institution and e-money institution licensed in Kosovo. It is the master pointer that seeds the actor map for every downstream A1 workstream cell.

source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (register of licensed financial institutions)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: enumerates licensed payment institutions and e-money institutions alongside banks. Snowballing this list yields the full population of non-bank payment/processing actors serving Kosovo.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës
source_name: Këshilli Kosovar për Raportim Financiar (KKRF) — auditor & audit-firm licensing register (regulator of the audit profession)
why_relevant: Statutory oversight body under the Ministry of Finance created by Law No. 06/L-032 on Accounting, Financial Reporting and Auditing. Its functions include licensing and publishing the register of statutory auditors, audit firms and recognised professional associations, plus quality-control inspections and disciplinary proceedings. The register is the canonical actor map for which firms may sign Kosovo bank statements. NOTE: the exact live URL for the register page was not confirmed in this pass — root domain is a best-inference and must be verified.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës
source_name: NJPMNP — Unit for Public Enterprise Policy and Monitoring, Ministry of Economy (list of central & local POEs)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map of Kosovo's publicly owned enterprises (central POEs such as KEK, KOSTT, Posta, water/waste utilities, plus ~55 local POEs). Utilities are the largest institutional buyers of bill-payment acceptance, POS/kiosk collection, payroll and cash-management banking services. Needed to enumerate the contracting authorities whose e-Prokurimi records must be tracked.

source_name: Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës (Kosovo Banking Association)
why_relevant: Sector body whose membership list is a second actor map and whose positions/communiqués often precede individual banks' public statements on fees, regulation and sector strategy. Its own domain was not confirmed by search; a member bank's page about it and its Facebook page are the confirmed handles.

source_name: STIKK — Shoqata e TIK-ut e Kosovës, member directory
why_relevant: STIKK claims to represent ~90% of Kosovo's ICT sector; its member profiles enumerate the local technology/software vendor universe — the pool from which bank IT suppliers, payment integrators and fintech startups are drawn. Directly answers 'which vendors are registered locally'.

source_name: Innovation Centre Kosovo (ICK) — incubator portfolio
why_relevant: Largest Kosovo tech incubator; has run 28 calls for business ideas including a dedicated Women-and-FinTech edition. Its portfolio/alumni listings are the most likely public enumeration of early-stage Kosovo fintech ventures, which no association directory covers.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo — "Open Businesses" project (scraped ARBK, ~170k businesses)
why_relevant: Civil-society open-data project with an accompanying GitHub scraper (opendatakosovo/open-arbk). The code documents ARBK's actual endpoints and field schema — the fastest way to understand how to query the registry reliably.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — American Chamber of Commerce in Kosovo
why_relevant: Foreign chamber whose membership skews to banks, payment providers and technology firms; its committees and event programme are a low-cost way to see which financial institutions and vendors are actively lobbying and partnering in Kosovo. BKT Kosova publicly flags its AmCham membership, confirming bank participation.

source_name: AMIK — Asociacioni i Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare të Kosovës, members page
why_relevant: Member-based association enumerating Kosovo's microfinance and non-bank lending institutions (KRK, Besëlidhja, AFK, FINCA Kosovë, KEP and others) — the second tier of credit actors that banking-only sources miss but that buy the same payment and core-banking technology.

source_name: Apps Run The World — enterprise-software customer database (Kosovo bank technographics)
why_relevant: Commercial technographics aggregator holding per-bank software purchase records — its Raiffeisen Bank Kosova profile records a Temenos T24 core-banking purchase. Aggregators like this are pointers: they name the vendor and year, which you then verify against vendor/bank primary sources.

source_name: ARBK Atlas — Kosovo Business Registry (240,000+ companies)
why_relevant: Commercial re-packaging of ARBK data with export, lead-search and market-insight features. Useful as a fast way to size and segment the registered universe (e.g. all entities with financial or ICT activity codes) even if the underlying data must be validated against ARBK.

source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — open mirror of the Kosovo business registry
why_relevant: Self-described largest open source of Kosovo business data; lets you search registrations, owners, activities and statistics without fighting the government portal's postback forms. Ideal for bulk actor enumeration by NACE/activity (financial intermediation, IT services) and for owner-graph snowballing.

source_name: Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit (BKS) — Kosovo Insurance Bureau
why_relevant: Administers compulsory motor insurance and is fully financed by the licensed insurers, so its constitution effectively lists every operating insurer in Kosovo. A reliable, membership-based enumeration of the insurance actor set.

entity_name: Dhoma e Tregtisë dhe Industrisë Kosovë
source_name: Dhoma e Tregtisë dhe Industrisë Kosovë (DHTIK) — alternative Kosovo chamber
why_relevant: A second, separate chamber alongside OEK. Kosovo's chamber landscape is fragmented (OEK, DHTIK, AKB, plus bilateral chambers), so covering only OEK would miss a distinct slice of the member universe.

source_name: Gjirafa.biz — Kosovo business directory (Western Union / money transfer agent listings)
why_relevant: Local business directory that enumerates MTO agent locations and financial-service outlets across Kosovo — a workable proxy for mapping the physical remittance distribution network, which no operator publishes in structured form.

source_name: INDEP — 'Mbrojtja e konsumatorëve në Kosovë: standardet, rregullat dhe politikat'
why_relevant: Maps Kosovo's consumer-protection institutional architecture and EU-acquis alignment; a pointer source that names the responsible bodies, laws and complaint routes to snowball from.

source_name: Kutia (Prishtina software company) — industry pages naming banking & finance clients
why_relevant: ISO 9001/20000/27001-certified Kosovo software house that states its solutions power banking and finance businesses. Domestic outsourcers' portfolio and case-study pages are one of the few places a Kosovo bank's digital project is publicly attributed.

source_name: MPRA / RePEc / IDEAS — academic working papers on Kosovo banking
why_relevant: Open academic aggregator holding papers such as a history of the development of Kosovo's banking sector; academic papers frequently cite and reproduce bank-level figures from CBK reports that are no longer online, effectively acting as a secondary archive plus a source of long-run series.

source_name: OCCRP Aleph — Kosovo Business Registration Agency dataset
why_relevant: Searchable archived snapshot of the ARBK registry inside an investigative document platform; valuable for historical states of the registry (past officers, past shareholders) that the live portal overwrites.

source_name: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (OEK) / Kosovo Chamber of Commerce
why_relevant: Statutory-origin chamber (Law No. 2004/7) with ~30 sectoral associations and 15,000+ members, explicitly including a banks-and-insurance grouping and an ICT grouping. Its sectoral structure and publications map which financial and technology actors organise collectively, and its sector studies name companies.

source_name: OEGJK / KDWV — Oda Ekonomike Gjermano-Kosovare (German-Kosovar Business Association)
why_relevant: One of the largest foreign business associations in Kosovo (~200 member companies) with a published board and an ICT sector overview page. Newsletters name newly joined members, giving a dated stream of new market entrants including technology and financial services firms.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Kosovo Business Registration Agency register
why_relevant: Normalised, cross-jurisdiction company records for Kosovo entities, which makes it the practical tool for linking a Kosovo subsidiary to its foreign parent (e.g. regional bank groups, payment vendors) — exactly the parent-child mapping needed before chasing group-level IR and annual reports.

source_name: PaymentProviders.io — Kosovo provider directory
why_relevant: Aggregator listing PSPs, gateways and acquirers claiming Kosovo coverage. Low authority on its own, but an efficient snowball surface for discovering processor and scheme-adjacent actor names to verify against the BQK register.

source_name: Prishtina Online — procurement directory of central institutions and municipalities
why_relevant: Aggregator listing central institutions and their procurement pages/contacts. Useful as a shortcut actor map for enumerating contracting authorities and their local procurement sections, especially where an authority does not mirror notices to the central portal cleanly.

source_name: Starlabs (Prishtina, 200+ engineers) — services and client references
why_relevant: Large Kosovo development agency offering custom software, QA and digital transformation; a plausible subcontractor on Kosovo bank digital projects. Its client/portfolio pages, and its profile on the Outsource2Kosovo directory, are candidate disclosure surfaces.

source_name: Third-party ARBK APIs (micro-devs, xk-business/applifyer)
why_relevant: Programmatic search/detail/CSV-export endpoints over ARBK registry data — the cheapest machine-readable path to enumerating Kosovo legal entities for entity-resolution against bank and vendor names.

source_name: Tracxn — Kosovo startups / funding database
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator listing Kosovo-registered startups with sector tags and funding events — a fast way to enumerate fintech/payments companies that never appear in the BQK register because they are unlicensed tech vendors or foreign-licensed.

source_name: WeBalkans EU - Kosovo EU funding and projects hub
why_relevant: EU-run aggregator of EU-funded projects and funding opportunities in Kosovo, published also in Albanian and Serbian. Useful as a snowball hub to identify named programmes and implementing partners that are then traced back to TED/IPA action documents.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of banks in Kosovo (actor-map pointer)
why_relevant: Fast, machine-readable roster mapping every licensed commercial bank to its official domain (PriBank, Banka Ekonomike, BKT, BpB, NLB, ProCredit, Raiffeisen, TEB, Ziraat, İşbank) — the seed list used to build this cell's crawl targets. Secondary to the CBK register for authority, but far easier to parse.
